bio: Erwin Denijs is a genuine ambassador of his region, the North Sea and Oosterschelde River. This “North Sea Chef” crafts the best seasonal produce into dishes that combine a tangy freshness with a playful element. For example, beurre blanc flanks a skate wing cooked in butter and paired with mussels and a medley of leeks. Caroline, your cheerful hostess, will ply you with wine, as well as beer tips, all of which in a pared-back setting that provides the perfect foil for striking works of art, starring fish!...
